narrative.overview:
The visual authority is `artifacts/story-visual/story-final.mp4`: a notched Root seal, radial inherited bands, deep forest, bone, sage, copper preview, editorial sans, Georgia italic, and mono data. Preserve the approved Story object and desktop composition. Command and Arena inherit its materials; their surface notes remain in `.impeccable/operations/DESIGN.md`.
This refresh supersedes the earlier Anton/WebGL/cast-loom guidance; its byte-identical archive is `artifacts/motion-pass/DESIGN-before.md`. Sources: `story-authority.css`, `work-language.css`, `authority-motion.ts/css`, `story-world.tsx`, `flat-authority-tree.tsx`, `command-continuity.tsx`, and `arena-world.tsx` under `web/src/components/`.
PRODUCT.md and AGENTS.md own accounting and integrations. This document describes presentation; animation and captures do not establish transaction evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Notched Root and radial inherited bands.
Flat financial Command and separate bone inspector.
Institutional mission and verifier in Arena.
Bounded native motion with explicit mobile/reduced-motion consequences.
dos: Do preserve the canonical Story, flat financial Command, exact native values, complete paths, and simulation/observed-state provenance.
Do keep Operations operational outside Research's blast radius and make consequences clear without motion.
donts: Don't restore superseded Anton/WebGL/cast-loom direction, redesign the frozen Story, or introduce decorative loops.
Don't imply delegation or revoke transfers tokens, label effectively blocked descendants as locally revoked, or invent settlement proof.
